headline: EQUINOX GOLD SWALLOWS ORLA IN $5.1B DEAL — North America's New Senior Producer Born
snippet: Equinox Gold (TSX: EQX) agreed to acquire Orla Mining in a cash-and-stock deal creating a combined company with a US$18.5 billion market cap and 1.1 million ounces of annual gold production anchored by three long-life Canadian mines. Backed by royalty legend Pierre Lassonde, the deal awaits shareholder votes in July with close expected in Q3 2026.

headline: COMEX COPPER SHATTERS ALL-TIME RECORD: $6.69/lb on US-Iran Supply Shock and AI Demand Surge
snippet: COMEX copper futures hit an all-time high of $6.69/lb on May 13 as sulphuric acid shortages tied to the US-Iran conflict tightened smelter output while global data centre build-outs amplified demand. LME prices rose 1.6% to $14,200/t, just $300 below London's record.

headline: SILVER SURGES TO $88/OZ — Hits 2-Month High as Industrial Demand Leaves Gold Behind
snippet: Silver climbed to $88 per ounce on May 13, its strongest print in two months, driven by tightening supply in solar, electronics, and energy storage while gold sold off on inflation fears. The metal is up 172% year-over-year, and the 2026 structural deficit is forecast to widen to 46.3 million ounces.

headline: GOLD CRACKS $4,680 After Hottest Inflation Since 2023 — Rate Cuts Fully Priced Out for 2026
snippet: US CPI hit 3.8% in April — above the 3.7% forecast and the highest since May 2023 — sending gold toward $4,680 as markets fully priced out any 2026 Fed rate cut and raised odds of another hike. At 16% off its $5,589 January all-time high, the structural bull case remains intact: central banks bought 244 tonnes in Q1 alone.

headline: USA RARE EARTH BEATS Q1 ESTIMATES: $5.7M Revenue, Stillwater Commissioned, $2.8B Serra Verde Deal Signed
snippet: USA Rare Earth (NYSE: USAR) posted Q1 revenue of $5.7M versus $4.2M consensus, with $1.75 billion in cash after closing a $1.5B PIPE. The company commissioned Phase 1a of its Stillwater magnet plant and signed a definitive deal to acquire Brazil's Serra Verde Group for $2.8 billion, cementing its claim as the largest integrated Western rare earth buildout.

headline: NdPr OXIDE SHEDS 21% IN APRIL — But Deficit Extends Into Year 2 as Western Supply Fails to Keep Pace
snippet: Neodymium-praseodymium oxide fell to $99.61/kg in April — its sharpest monthly correction since the Q1 rally began — following a 105% surge driven by record EV registration data. The market is consolidating in a $95–$115/kg range but remains in structural deficit for the second consecutive year as Chinese quota expansions and Western ramp-ups lag EV and wind demand.

headline: Selkirk Copper DISCOVERS 117 Lens: 1.27% Cu, 0.89 g/t Au Over 12.6m Beneath Former Yukon Open Pit
snippet: Selkirk Copper Mines (TSXV: SCMI) found the 117 Lens below the former Minto open pit in Yukon, returning 1.27% Cu, 0.89 g/t Au, and 5.91 g/t Ag (1.98% CuEq) over 12.6 metres. A 50,000-metre Phase 2 program is underway targeting the new zone alongside established Minto North and Area 118 targets; resource estimate and PEA expected mid-2026.

headline: Wallbridge Mining Martiniere Drill: 4.53 g/t Au Over 13.5m, 3.11 g/t Over 18.4m — Dragonfly Corridor Keeps Growing
snippet: Wallbridge Mining (TSX: WM) released Phase 1 drill results from Martiniere in Quebec with the Dragonfly Corridor returning multiple wide, high-grade intervals including 4.53 g/t Au over 13.5m and 3.11 g/t Au over 18.4m. Phase 2 begins immediately on the open-ended system as Phase 1 wraps.

headline: Brunswick Exploration: 17.7m at 1.10% Li2O Within 123m at 0.72% — Anatacau 'Well-Formed System' Open in Every Direction
snippet: Brunswick Exploration (TSX-V: BRW) reported 17.7m at 1.10% Li2O within a broader 123m interval at 0.72% Li2O at Anatacau Main in James Bay, Quebec, while also returning some of the region's highest-grade cesium intercepts, hinting at a multi-payable-mineral play. Three more holes from the 2026 winter campaign are pending assay.

headline: NevGold's Nevada Antimony-Gold Project Approaches Maiden Resource With C$42M in Treasury
snippet: NevGold Corp. (TSX-V: NAU) released results from 10 of 17 drill holes at Limousine Butte, Nevada, returning up to 0.55 g/t Au and 0.34% Sb over 12.5 metres on the only primary antimony-gold project in the state. A maiden mineral resource estimate is imminent; the company carries C$42M in treasury and was named a TSX-V Top 50 Company for 2026.

headline: Why JP Morgan and Institutional Forecasters Still See Gold at $5,000 by Q4 — Despite the Inflation Pullback
snippet: Despite a 16% correction from gold's January $5,589 record, JP Morgan holds a Q4 2026 average target of $5,055/oz, citing 244 tonnes of central bank buying in Q1 and bar-and-coin demand at its second-highest quarterly level ever. The analysis argues the current pullback is a correction inside a structural bull market driven by geopolitical safe-haven demand and dollar weakness.
